# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: notification-worker.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: notification-worker
  team: platform
  tier: high
  description: Background worker for email, SMS, and push notifications
spec:
  type: worker
  slos:
    delivery-success:
      target: 99.5
      window: 30d
    processing-latency-p95:
      target: 98.0
      window: 30d
    queue-lag:
      target: 99.0
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: notification_cache
    type: database
    critical: false
  ownership:
    team: platform
